text:
Hood iQ needs a Data Scientist who can turn complex, culture-specific data into reliable algorithms, support trading logic, and help ensure the platform stays aligned with compliance requirements.

I’m Tobias Reyne, and with 7 years of experience building data-driven full-stack products, I’d be glad to support this work. My background includes JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML, and CSS, which means I’m comfortable working across the product layer as well as the systems that power it. While my recent work has focused on product engineering, the same discipline applies here: structuring data cleanly, designing dependable logic, and building systems that are practical to maintain.

In one project, I built a white-label class booking app for Pulsebox Studios using Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma, and Stripe. Each studio got its own subdomain, timetable, and memberships. The result was 64 studios onboarded in 6 months. That experience is relevant to your need for flexible order types and asset workflows, where the system must adapt cleanly to different use cases without becoming brittle.

I also built an internal staff onboarding portal for healthcare staffing using React, NestJS, PostgreSQL, TypeORM, and Auth0. Nurses uploaded credentials, managers approved them, and permissions were controlled by region. That portal supported 2,400 staff and reduced onboarding paperwork from 5 days to 1 day. I mention this because your role involves collaboration across teams and careful handling of sensitive, regulated information, both of which depend on clear logic and reliable access patterns.

For Hood iQ, I’d focus on:
- helping structure data pipelines and product logic for asset quantification
- supporting algorithmic features that compare assets and trading pairs
- working with teams to keep implementations secure, auditable, and aligned with compliance needs

I’m especially interested in problems where data, product design, and operational constraints overlap. If you’re looking for someone who can reason carefully about systems and build with discipline, I’d be excited to talk.
